S1.label: fig:sup_theory
S1.place_after: \subsection{Closed forms against Monte Carlo: all six panels}\label{sup:theoryfig}
S1.body: Figure~\ref{fig:sup_theory} checks the post-onset, horizon, order-statistic, integration, Doppler and certificate calculations.
S1.caption_new_tail: Doppler offsets are relative to clutter. In (f), interference is 30~dB above local power; curves join Monte Carlo estimates. Open downward triangles mark no false alarm in $10^5$ episodes and are drawn at the resolution $10^{-5}$.

S2.label: fig:sup_synthetic
S2.body: Figure~\ref{fig:sup_synthetic} compares exact and simulated clutter-to-noise-ratio-conditional coverage at nominal 0.90.
S2.caption_replace: Synthetic verification: coverage conditional on the true clutter-to-noise ratio. The line is the exact law of Proposition~1; markers are simulation.
S2.caption_new: Synthetic verification: coverage conditional on the true clutter-to-noise ratio. The blue line is the exact law of Proposition~\ref{M-prop:law}; open circles are its simulation. Other markers show the comparison methods. Each panel uses 200 replications with $m=16$ at nominal coverage 0.90; Monte Carlo standard error is at most 0.0014.

S3.label: fig:sup_texture
S3.place_after: \subsection{Texture-conditional coverage and disc widths on IPIX}
S3.body: Figure~\ref{fig:sup_texture} compares texture-conditional coverage; the following table reports coverage and disc widths.
S3.caption_replace: Coverage by texture quintile on IPIX (rotations 2--3, $m=16$). Texture is proxied by the local clutter power ($\pm1024$ pulses, excluding the episode).
S3.caption_new: Coverage by texture quintile on IPIX (rotations 2--3, $m=16$). Texture is proxied by the local clutter power ($\pm1024$ pulses, excluding the episode). Shading shows the expected maximum quintile deviation from sampling noise alone; it is a reference band, not a confidence interval for the plotted curves.

S4.label: fig:sup_detection
S4.body_replace: The additional detection figure retains the $10^{-3}$ level and full method curves.
S4.body_new: Figure~\ref{fig:sup_detection} retains the $10^{-3}$ design rate and full method curves.
S4.caption_replace: Injected Swerling-1 onset detection on IPIX at design false-alarm probabilities 0.01 and 0.001, from the frozen detection output.
S4.caption_new: Injected Swerling-1 onset detection on IPIX at design false-alarm probabilities 0.01 and 0.001 ($m=16$, conformal thresholds). Empirical and law curves are unweighted unit means; circles show the fitted-model law of Corollary~\ref{M-cor:detect}. Reported SCR gains average per-unit gains.

S5.label: fig:sup_ground
S5.body_replace: The general-form gain curve is post hoc.
S5.body_new: Figure~\ref{fig:sup_ground} shows coverage and onset gain by CNR class; the general-form gain curve is post hoc.
S5.caption_replace: 77~GHz ground-clutter coverage by CNR class and SCR gain over local power. The general-form gain interpretation is post hoc.
S5.caption_new: 77~GHz ground clutter: (a) coverage by CNR class at nominal 0.90; (b) onset SCR gain over local power for $P_{\rm d}=0.5$ at design $P_{\rm fa}=0.01$. The general-form gain interpretation is post hoc. CNR classes have unequal support, detailed in the text.
